scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run assemble && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.typecheck:gated: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm --filter @workspace/scripts --filter @workspace/api-server --filter @workspace/codetry-handbook --filter @workspace/headwaters-books --filter @workspace/practitioners-guide-v2 --filter @workspace/library --filter @workspace/practitioner-operating-plan --filter @workspace/north-star --filter @workspace/field-guide-finance --filter @workspace/print-marketing --filter @workspace/hinterland --filter @workspace/k-pizza --filter @workspace/codetry-ship --filter @workspace/deer-lake-store-plan run typecheck
